name: _slerp that assumes unit vectors
plain: A second slerp in the same Akatz file does no normalising. It takes the dot of the raw flattened tensors and clamps it to ±1 before acos. For anything not already unit length the clamp saturates, so ω ends up near 0 or near π and the weights blow up or collapse.
math:
dots=Σ a·b (raw), ω=acos(clamp(dots, −1+1e−7, 1−1e−7))
out=[sin((1−t)ω)/sin ω]a+[sin(tω)/sin ω]b
nlerp sibling: lerp then divide by its norm with no rescale, output is unit length.
